raw_segments.text: Brutus, O Antony, beg not your death of us, though now we must appear bloody and cruel,
as by our hands and this our present act you see we do, yet see you but our hands and this
the bleeding business they have done.
Our hearts you see not, they are pitiful, and pity to the general wrong of Rome as fire
drives out fire, so pity, pity hath done this deed on Caesar.
For your part to you our swords have leaden points, mark Antony, our arms in strength
of malice, and our hearts of brother's temper, do receive you in with all kind love, good
